nfd4e184be8.headline: "Planning" issues a report on the Egypt Government Excellence Award and its updates for 2020
nfd4e184be8.summary: Egypt's Ministry of Planning and Economic Development issued a report on updates and new categories for the 2020 Government Excellence Award compared to 2019.
nfd4e184be8.why: Government awards promoting excellence can encourage better public sector performance and economic development.
